tools.name: astrbot_send_message
tools.description: Send a message into a QQ conversation through the AstrBot bridge. Text, an image, or both. Omit conv_id to reply in the conversation the latest event came from.

text.description: Message text to send. Plain text only.

image.description: A log: attachment handle to send as an image, for example the one printed as [blob log:abcdef12.jpg image/jpeg] in a pet_cua_screenshot receipt. Only when the person who asked has screenshot permission.

conv_kind.description: Conversation kind. Defaults to the latest conversation.

conv_id.description: Group id or user id. Defaults to the latest conversation.

reply_to.description: Optional bridge message id to quote as a reply.

summary.zh: 经 AstrBot 的桥往一个 QQ 会话发一条消息：文字、图片，或两者一起。图片用 pet_cua_screenshot 回执里的 log: 句柄。
summary.en: Sends text, an image, or both into a QQ conversation through the AstrBot bridge. Images use the log: handle from a pet_cua_screenshot receipt.

tools.name: astrbot_status
tools.description: Report the AstrBot bridge connection state, the bot name the bridge reports, and the QQ conversations seen in this session.

summary.zh: 报告桥的连接状态、桥自报的身份与本次见过的 QQ 会话。
summary.en: Reports bridge connection state, the reported bot identity and the QQ conversations seen this session.

tools.name: astrbot_read_history
tools.description: Read the QQ messages this bot has seen: the latest ones in a conversation, or those containing a keyword. Use it when someone refers to something said earlier.

keyword.description: Only messages containing this text (case-insensitive). Leave out to read the latest.

limit.description: How many messages, default 20, at most 100.

context.description: With keyword: how many messages around each hit, default 2.

sender.description: Only messages from this QQ number.

conv_id.description: Group id or user id. Defaults to the latest conversation.

summary.zh: 读或搜这个 bot 见过的 QQ 消息：某会话最近的若干条，或含关键词的那些。
summary.en: Reads or searches the QQ messages this bot has seen: the latest in a conversation, or those containing a keyword.

tools.name: astrbot_call_tool
tools.description: Call one of the AstrBot tools enabled for this bridge, by name and with its own arguments. The list of available tools is in your environment prompt (astrbot.tools); if it looks stale, call astrbot_status. A tool runs with the identity of the person whose message started this turn, so admin-only tools are refused when a group member is talking.

name.description: Tool name exactly as listed in astrbot.tools.

args.description: Arguments for that tool, following its own parameter description.

summary.zh: 按名字调用 AstrBot 上启用的一个工具；用触发这一轮的那条消息的身份执行。
summary.en: Calls one of the AstrBot tools enabled for the bridge, running as the person whose message started this turn.

description.zh: 桥送来的 QQ 消息；被点名时立即投递，其余按配置合批。
description.en: A QQ message from the bridge; delivered at once when the bot is called, otherwise batched per config.

description.zh: 与 AstrBot 的桥建立连接。
description.en: The connection to the AstrBot bridge was established.

description.zh: 与 AstrBot 的桥断开，正在重连。
description.en: The AstrBot bridge connection dropped and is being retried.

description.zh: 桥转述的状态通知，例如 AstrBot 侧的 QQ 掉线。
description.en: A status notice relayed by the bridge, such as the QQ side going offline.

prompts.title: AstrBot · 环境提示词

changelog.1.1.3:
- 工具清单带参数签名（query_lyrics_by_name(song_name)），模型不用猜参数名。
- 环境提示词加一条通用策略：能直接用工具做的事，不要绕道去操作屏幕或凭记忆编。
changelog.1.1.2: - 工具清单为空时明确提示「如果主人刚开过，调 astrbot_status 看最新清单」——避免开完工具还要重启。
changelog.1.1.1:
- 新增 `astrbot_call_tool`：按名字调用 AstrBot 上启用的工具，用**触发这一轮的那条消息**的身份执行（群友就是群友，管理员工具会被 AstrBot 自己的权限层拦下）。
- 握手后接收桥下发的 `tools` 清单，列进环境提示词；`astrbot_status` 也会报当前可用的工具。
- 桥在管理页保存白名单后会重推清单，不用重连。
changelog.1.0.4:
- README 修正协议说明：`capabilities.images` 只在 `hello` 帧里自报，`ready` 帧不带；并说明它只在重连时刷新。
- 补上实机验证环境（Cortico 0.2.8 / Coopanion 0.2.12）。
changelog.1.0.3: - 加心跳与静默检测：休眠唤醒、切换网络、对端进程消失时，socket 可能「开着但永远没有下文」，而 `close` 事件不会来。现在每 20 秒 ping 一次，60 秒没有任何往来就主动重建，不再静默丢消息。
changelog.1.0.2:
- 桥的 `error` 事件只认现役 socket：重启时旧连接迟到的错误不再被当成新连接的错误记一条。
- `start()` 先撤掉挂起的重连定时器。之前退避等待期间重新连接，会同时留下两条 socket（桥会把旧的踢掉，但会多一次握手）。
changelog.1.0.1: - 加上扩展图标（`cortico.icon`），首发时市场卡片是空白的。
changelog.1.0.0:
首个公开版本。

- 通过 AstrBot 侧的桥接入 QQ：QQ 账号、白名单与全部插件仍归 AstrBot，Cortico 的人格只负责说什么。
- 两种消息范围：`mention`（默认）只投递被 @ 或叫到称呼的消息，`all` 群里每条都投递；私聊一律投递。
- 工具：`astrbot_send_message`（文字、图片、引用回复）、`astrbot_status`、`astrbot_read_history`（最近 / 关键词 / 发送者 / 会话）。
- 图片双向：端点能读图就传原图，否则由桥用视觉模型转述；也可以只要占位。
- 群通知：撤回（带被撤回的原文）、戳一戳（戳到自己显示「你」）、入群、退群、管理员变更、上传文件；只排队不唤醒。
- 主人身份来自桥自报的 AstrBot 管理员名单，不另设名单；截图授权随发言人实时变化。
- 断线按指数退避重连，超时与失败不拖垮装配。
changelog.0.1.0: 内部试用版：消息推送、发消息、查状态、重连。
